resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts both say abandoned; the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Idaho list says Tower Gone. The story reports the disagreement and the record is not changed; the editor decides which status to show.

notes_for_editor: The 1930 and 1938 dates and the design agree across the three pages that give them. The status conflict is for the editor: two pages say abandoned and the FFLA list says Tower Gone; the record's gone is supported only by that list, so the story uses abandoned and reports the disagreement. No abandonment date appears in the sources, so no abandoned event is recorded. The patrol point on Badger Mountain comes from Firelookout.com only. No staffing history appears in the sources read.
